load_fasttext_model: load a binarized fastText model from a given file path
read_txt_embeddings: read pretrained word embeddings from a text file and return word2id mapping with torch tensor
load_bin_embeddings: load pretrained word embeddings from a fastText binary file and return word2id mapping with torch tensor
load_embeddings: load pretrained word embeddings from either a text or fastText binary file based on extension
test_load_embeddings: test the load_embeddings function with both .txt and .bin embedding file paths
